row.question: Will Monad conduct an airdrop before Oct 1, 2025?
row.description:
If Monad conducts an airdrop before Oct 1, 2025, then the market resolves to Yes.
An airdrop is defined as the distribution of fungible tokens to multiple wallet addresses where recipients receive tokens without paying the full market value. This includes free distributions requiring only gas fees, distributions requiring donations less than 10% of market value, retroactive rewards, task-based distributions, and phased distributions where initial tokens are received before the deadline. Token sales where recipients pay 10% or more of market value, ICOs, IDOs, employee compensation, liquidity mining rewards, staking rewards, NFTs, non-transferable tokens, and unconverted points do not constitute airdrops. The airdrop must be conducted (tokens actually distributed) before the deadline, not merely announced.

row.question: Will Karoline Leavitt be more than 15 minutes late to next Press Briefing?
row.description:
If Karoline Leavitt is late to the next Press Briefing by above 15 minutes before Jan 2, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
Lateness is measured as the difference between scheduled start time and actual arrival time, rounded to the nearest minute (5:30 rounds to 6, 5:15 rounds to 5). Scheduled start time is the last officially published time. Actual start time is when the person first appears at their designated speaking position. If the person is early or exactly on time, all contracts resolve to No except the 0-minute contract. If the event is delayed for reasons beyond the person's control, lateness is measured from when they reach their position. If the person cancels or fails to appear, all contracts resolve to Yes. If the person appears at the venue but doesn't take their position, the contract resolves to No. *For the purpose of this market, rounding down to any of the strike times will not count as "above." For example, if Leavitt is 5:15 minutes late, the 'above 5 minutes' contract resolves to No.*
